cook.speaker: COOK
pages: He's through that door and down again. After dark. Mind the third step. It has opinions.

meet.speaker: DR. KESSEL
pages: Mm. The fixer's ghost. Sit. Not there, that one's for the dead. There.
Deleted overnight? It's going around.
I can't give you your record back. Nobody can. But I can give you a way to talk to doors that won't hear you.

what.speaker: DR. KESSEL
pages: An implant for your deck. It sees the wiring behind a thing, and lets you ask it, in its own language.
I built half the scanners on that street, once. Consider this an apology to somebody.

fitted.speaker: DR. KESSEL
pages: Hold still. … There.
Try it on the shutter. H to look behind it, then pick a verb. Open it.

shutter.speaker: DR. KESSEL
pages: The shutter. H, then open. It will not bite. What is behind it might stare.

after.speaker: DR. KESSEL
pages: Shells. Robot bodies, empty. People sell me their old ones. People sell me all sorts.
Don't ask what I do with them. I'll tell you, and you'll stop sleeping.
Go home. Your front door won't know you, but your block has a service latch down the areaway out front. It speaks the same language as that shutter.

hello.speaker: DR. KESSEL
pages: Mm. Not now. I'm between patients, and you are not one yet.

sweep.speaker: DR. KESSEL
pages: In. Down. Mind the step. The fixer sent you? Good. Sit. Not there. There.
They're on the street with a list. The ones on it, and anyone standing near.
I'd put you in a shell, but look at them: not one has a working core. I can't put you anywhere.

choices.label: (Something with one glove comes down the ladder.)

dlv.speaker: DLV-9
pages: DLV-9 HAS A WORKING CORE. DLV-9 HAS ROOM.
DLV-9 HAS WAITED FORTY-SIX DAYS FOR A DESTINATION.
ROUTE SET. DESTINATION: YOU.

copy.speaker: DR. KESSEL
pages: A copy. Not a move: a copy. The you in this chair stays in this chair, and they will take it.
The one in the frame wakes up. Hardly anyone does. I said hardly.
Boots on the street. Decide.

done.speaker: DR. KESSEL
pages: Hold still. Look at the glove. … There.

after-copy.speaker: DR. KESSEL
pages: Go on. Both of you.
